field.name: RequirementIds.parse result
field.type: { date: string; hash8: string; story?: number | undefined; fr: number } | undefined
field.purpose: Stored requirement ids carry only the date and the first 8 hash characters, so parse returns those parts (story and fr as numbers) instead of epicHash, ordinal and storyId.

body.rationale: The interface sketch in sc1 cannot be implemented from stored requirement ids: they contain no full epic hash. The existing parseFrId result is what its tests and callers rely on. Two identical pending amendments (AMD-2f27754d4ad00b8e-1 and -2) already record this; -2 is to be rejected and -1 approved.
